## What is wrong?

Describe the concrete problem, affected users/generations/deployments, and impact.

## How was it detected?

Link the report, failing test, logs, or protocol evidence. Distinguish real device
observations from synthetic fixtures or assumptions.

## What needs to change?

State the required behavior and compatibility constraints.

## How does this PR fix it?

Explain the implementation and why it meets those requirements.

## Validation and upgrade compatibility

Give exact test commands, results, environment/architecture, and before/after
behavior. For startup/data/permission changes, cover existing installations and
unattended updates, not just fresh installs. State whether Home Assistant
Supervisor, Gen3 hardware, and Gen4 hardware were actually tested. List gaps and
rollback/data-migration implications; use N/A with a reason where appropriate.

## AI assistance

State whether AI tools were used to create this PR. If so, identify the assisted
parts (code/tests/docs/description), the human review or device checks performed,
and remaining uncertainty. Do not claim human review that did not happen.
